metaTitle: How to Choose a Camping Knife or Multitool
description: Choose a camping knife or multitool by blade steel, shape, lock and handle, with safety, sharpening and travel tips for campers and backpackers.
directAnswer: Most campers do well with a fixed blade of 3.5 to 4.5 inches in mid-range stainless plus a pocket multitool for repairs. Choose a locking blade, a comfortable handle and a good sheath, and keep the edge sharp.
